blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking several tokens per denoising step, but their reverse process is typically factorized over positions, limiting sample quality in the few-step regime where diffusion’s speed advantage over autoregressive decoding matters most. A recent line of work introduces a continuous Gaussian latent, trained as a variational autoencoder, to capture correlations across positions, but such approaches are prone to posterior collapse, where the latent is silently ignored. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE) , which builds the reverse process as a mixture of factorized distributions over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone, without increasing active parameters over the factorized baseline. Across synthetic multi-modal benchmarks, binarized MNIST, and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over factorized baselines.
blocks.zh: 假面扩散模型(MDMs)通过在逐个解密步骤中逐渐解开数个符号来生成序列,但其反向过程通常在位置上被因素化,限制了少数步骤制度中的样本质量,在少数步骤中,扩散速度优势比自动退步解码更重要。 最近一行工作引入了连续高斯语潜伏,作为变异自编码器训练,以捕捉不同位置的关联性,但这类方法容易在后期崩溃,潜伏性被默默忽略. 我们提议加强专家的混合,将这种过程建设成一种混合,即一种因子化的分布方式,即由专家决定的专家主干线所赋予的离散的共享潜伏物,而不超出因子化基线增加积极参数。 通过合成多模式基准、二进制的MNIST和LM1B,E-MOE比因子化基线改进了几步生成。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoregressive (AR) language models ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ; Brown et al., 2020 ; Yoo et al., 2026a ) are common and widespread approach for language modeling. They
factorize text along a fixed left-to-right order and generate one token per forward pass conditioned on previous tokens with causal attention. That ordering makes the likelihood exactly tractable, but it also makes decoding inherently sequential. Each token conditions on all previous ones, so a sequence of length L costs L forward passes that cannot be parallelized.
blocks.zh:
自动递减(AR)语言模型(Vaswani等人,2017年;Brown等人,2020年;Yoo等人,2026a)是通用和广泛的语言模型方法. 他们
将文本按照固定的左对右顺序作为要素,并产生每个前传的1个令牌,以先前的令牌为条件,并给予因果关注。 这种定购令使可能性完全可以拉动,但也使编码本身具有顺序性。 所有前作的每个标志性条件,所以L的长度顺序成本L前行通行证不能并行.

blocks.en: Recently, Masked Diffusion Models (MDM) ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Lou et al., 2024 ; Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) have suggested a different approach based on diffusion forward and backward processes with T steps. While the forward process gradually masks each token independently, the factorized model conditions on the whole sequence, with likelihood evaluated via bounds or estimators ( Ivanov et al., 2026 ) , and predicts multiple tokens per forward pass with bidirectional attention at the each of T steps of backward process. Thus, MDM recover a sequence of length L costs T < L \text{T}<\text{L} forward passes, allowing for using of parallelization.
blocks.zh: 最近,Masked扩散模型(MDM)(Austin等人,2021年;Lou等人,2024年;Sahoo等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年)提出了基于传播的有T级步骤的前向和后向过程的不同方法. 虽然前进过程逐渐独立地掩盖了每个符号,但整个序列上的因子化模型条件,通过边框或估计器(Ivanov等人,2026年)来评价可能性,并预测每个前进的符号会在落后过程的每个T步骤上以双向的注意通过. 因此,MDM恢复了L的长度序列成本T < L\text{T}<\text{L}前传通行证,允许使用平行化.

blocks.en: In practice, MDM still need many unmasking steps to produce coherent text. One of the main reason is the factorization of a backward process. Although, model conditions on a whole sequence, it predicts an independent marginal distributions for every masked positions. Thereby, the factorization causes the absence of correlations between unmasked tokens obtained through a forward pass. Sampling several positions from these marginals treats them as conditionally independent and discards the dependencies between them ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , an error that grows with the number of tokens unmasked at once, precisely where parallel unmasking would pay off.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,MDM仍然需要许多不露面的步骤来产生一致的文本. 主要原因之一是一个落后过程的因子化. 虽然,整个序列上的模型条件,它预测每个蒙面位置都有独立的边际分布. 因此,因子化导致通过前传获得的未蒙面的代币之间缺乏关联. 从这些边缘地区抽取几个位置,将它们视为有条件的独立,并丢弃它们之间的依附关系(Liu等人,2025年),这个错误随着一瞬间解开的符号数量而增加,正是在平行解密会有所回报的地方.

blocks.en: One way to overcome the factorization error is to consideration of shared latent variable ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , that models hidden joint representation of current context and predicted sequence. Existing instantiations ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Shariatian et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) take this latent to be continuous and train it with an auxiliary recognition network alongside MDM. The continuous structure of latent requires parametric prior, in practice a Gaussian, thereby not allowing for constructing more informative prior from data. The joint training of MDM with an additional recognition network implies the increasing of learnable parameters in the training stage. We ask whether such a latent can be obtained without restricting to fixed prior and joint training with an additional network. We positively answer to the question and model the reverse process over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbone ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) - an architecture already used to scale MDM ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025a ) . The same router, evaluated on the noisy and on the clean sequence, serves as both the generative prior and the training-time variational posterior, so no recognition model is added and no prior over the latent has to be designed. Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 克服因素化误差的一种方法是考虑共享潜在变量(Xie等人,2026年),即模型隐藏当前上下文和预测序列的联合代表. 现有的即时报道(Xie等人,2026年;Shariatian等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2026年)以这种潜伏状态连续进行,并用一个辅助识别网络与MDM一起训练. 潜伏结构的连续性需要先参数,实际上需要高斯人,因此无法先从数据中构建更多的信息。 管理与发展部的联合培训加上一个额外的承认网络意味着培训阶段可学习的参数增加。 我们询问能否在不仅限于与一个额外的网络进行固定的前期和联合培训的情况下获得这种潜在机会。 我们积极地回答一个问题,并将反向过程模拟在一个专家混合骨干(MoE)的专家路线决定所赋予的离散的共同潜伏之上(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年)——一个已经用于MDM规模的架构(Nie等人,2025年;Zhu等人,2025年a年)。 同一路由器在噪音和干净的序列上得到评价,它既作为先基因,又作为训练时间的变异后基因,因此没有添加识别模型,也不必设计先于潜伏物。 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en:
• Method. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE) for overcoming the factorization error, reusing a mixture of experts as a mixture of factorized
distributions : the per-token and per-layer routing decisions an MoE backbone already computes serve as the discrete shared latent, at no extra parameters and no extra inference cost
(Section 3 ). • Training objective. We derive the evidence lower bound (ELBO) for this mixture-based reverse process, together with a tractable bound on its latent KL that reduces to a per-layer and per-token quantity computed from the router itself (Section 3 ). • Empirical results. On synthetic multi-modal data, binarized MNIST and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over both a factorized baseline and a continuous-latent one at matched sample entropy, and its latent remains in use throughout training without warmup schedules or auxiliary losses (Section 5 ).

To avoid a learning of additional models as VAE in VADD during the training stage, we instead use the routing decisions of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . This latent is the discrete choice of which expert, or sparse mixture
of experts, should explain the unmasking step.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Distillation of MDM. One line of work keeps the factorized parameterization of MDLM ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) and shortens the sampling trajectory instead. SDTT ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2025 ) distills MDMs into itself progressively, reducing the number of sampling steps by a factor of two at each stage. DUO ( Sahoo et al., 2025 ; Deschenaux et al., 2026 ) derives a duality between uniform-state discrete and Gaussian diffusion and uses it to port consistency distillation to the discrete setting. DiMO ( Zhu et al., 2025b ) matches the teacher in a single forward pass and IDLM ( Li et al., 2026a ) trains the student adversarially in the inverse direction. However, these methods require a pre-trained model, whereas we train our model from scratch, therefore, these works are out of scope.
blocks.zh: MDM的沉淀 一行工作保持了MDLM的因子化参数化(Sahoo等人,2024年),而是缩短了采样轨迹. SDTT(Deschenaux and Gulcehre,2025年)逐渐将MDMs蒸馏成本身,在每一阶段将取样步骤的数量减少两个系数。 DUO(Sahoo等人,2025年;Deschenaux等人,2026年)在统一状态离散和高斯扩散之间产生双重性,并将其用于向离散环境移植一致性蒸馏。 DiMO(Zhu等人,2025年b)在单向前传和IDLM(Li等人,2026年a)对学生进行反向的对抗训练中与老师匹配. 然而,这些方法需要一个经过预先训练的模型,而我们从零开始训练我们的模型,因此这些工程超出了范围.

blocks.en: Overcoming the factorization error. We ask instead whether a model can express correlated steps natively. DCD ( Liu et al., 2025 ) augments the denoiser with a copula model that restores the joint structure among simultaneously denoised positions, and CoDD ( Li et al., 2026b ) replaces the factorized output with a tractable correlated layer. Another group changes the process itself: ReDi ( Yoo et al., 2026b ) re-couples the trajectories so as to reduce the conditional total correlation, and FLDD ( Bartosh et al., 2026 ) learns the forward process with the same goal. However, these methods either incur significant computational overhead or rely on post-training fine-tuning. Closest to us is VADD ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , which introduces a shared Gaussian latent. As Table 1 makes precise, E-MoE keeps this mixture view, but its latent is the routing decision the backbone already computes: the prior is learned from data and no recognition network is needed.
blocks.zh: 克服因素化错误 。 相反,我们问一个模式是否能够在本土表达相互关联的步骤。 DCD(Liu等人,2025年)用一个复联模型来增强denoiser,该模型恢复了同时去诺化位置之间的联合结构,CoDD(Li等人,2026b)用可牵引的关联层取代了因子化输出. 另一个组会改变进程本身 : ReDi(Yoo等人,2026年b)重新将轨迹连接起来,以减少有条件的总关联,FLDD(Bartosh等人,2026年)以相同的目标学习前进过程. 然而,这些方法要么需要大量的计算间接费用,要么依靠培训后微调。 与我们最接近的是VADD(谢等人,2026年),它引入了共享的高斯潜质. 如表1所示,E-MOE保持这种混合观点,但其潜伏之处在于主干线已经计算出的路由决定:先从数据中得知,不需要识别网络。

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate E-MoE on three tasks: two-dimensional toy examples (Section 5.1 ), pixel-level image generation (Section 5.2 ), and text generation (Section 5.3 ). Throughout, we compare three models – a factorized MDLM ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ) baseline, VADD ( Xie et al., 2026 ) , and E-MoE – matched in backbone size, optimizer and training budget, so any gain comes from the routing mechanism alone . The experimental details are in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 5.1 Two-dimensional toy examples
blocks.zh: 5.1 二维玩具实例

blocks.en: A factorized reverse process can only represent per-position marginals, so at low NFE it can combine independently-sampled, individually-plausible values into a joint sample that does not exist in the data. We test whether E-MoE’s shared discrete latent fixes this on two synthetic 2-D densities where the failure is easy to see and measure.

blocks.en: We generate n = 20,000 n=20{,}000 points per density, discretized into 𝒱 = 50 \mathcal{V}=50 tokens per coordinate ( L = 2 L=2 ). 8-modes places M = 8 M=8 Gaussian clusters. A factorized sampler can combine two clusters’ coordinates into a spurious mode that lies between them and matches neither. Swiss-roll instead places mass on a thin 1-D spiral. The analogous failure fills the area around the manifold. The experimental setup details are provided in Appendix B.1 .

Table 2 confirms this quantitatively: both VADD and E-MoE substantially improve validity over factorized MDLM in the few-step regime, with E-MoE consistently outperforming VADD on 8-modes and remaining competitive on Swiss-roll.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We develop an MDM based on a mixture of factorized marginals conditioned on discrete latent codes drawn from an informative data prior, which is learned with no extra models, using the same network as for clean token prediction, in order to model correlations between predicted tokens. Marginalizing over routes couples tokens unmasked in the same step, which helps break the factorization barrier: E-MoE improves few-step generation on synthetic densities, binarized MNIST and LM1B, lowering generative perplexity on LM1B by at least 2 × 2\times at one and two steps.
blocks.zh: 我们开发一个基于基于先前从信息性数据中提取的离散潜在代码的元素化边际的组合的MDM,通过使用与清洁信号预测相同的网络来学习,以便模拟预测信号之间的关联。 在路线上边缘的情侣标志在同一步骤中解开,这有助于打破因素化障碍:E-MOE在合成密度上改进了几步生成,二进制的MNIST和LM1B,在LM1B上至少降低2×2\时的基因偏差,一阶两步.

We use two densities on the plane, 8-modes and Swiss-roll, and turn every point into a length- 2 2 token sequence by discretizing its two coordinates independently: we place 49 49 uniform bin edges on [ − 3 , 3 ] [-3,3] , which yields K = 50 \text{K}=50 tokens per coordinate and L = 2 L=2 . 8-modes draws 8 8 cluster centres uniformly from [ − 2.5 , 2.5 ] 2 [-2.5,2.5]^{2} , picks a cluster index uniformly for every point, and adds isotropic Gaussian noise with standard deviation 0.09 0.09 . The clusters are small and well separated, so pairing the first coordinate of one cluster with the second coordinate of another lands on
a point that belongs to no cluster, which is exactly the failure a factorized sampler commits. blocks.en: We follow VADD’s evaluation regime ( Xie et al., 2026 ) and use the standard split of 60,000 60{,}000 training and 10,000 10{,}000 test images. Grayscale MNIST images are padded with 2 2 zero pixels on each side to 32 × 32 32\times 32 and binarized at a threshold of 0.5 0.5 . Each image is then a sequence of L = 1024 L=1024 binary tokens ( K = 2 \text{K}=2 ) under the same absorbing masked-diffusion process used for text, so a reverse step that reveals many pixels at once faces the same conditional independence problem as a reverse step that reveals many words at once.

blocks.en: • MDLM and AR . We reproduce MDLM training for 1 1 M steps under the protocol below. Our evaluation reproduces official publicly reported test perplexities ( 31.90 31.90 against 31.87 31.87 for MDLM and 22.83 22.83 against 22.8 22.8 for the AR transformer), which validates the correctness of the pipeline. • VADD . A global continuous latent of dimension d z = 512 d_{z}=512 injected through adaLN, estimated with a single particle by a recognition network that is a second transformer of the same size. The KL weight is annealed linearly from 0 0 to 1 1 over the first 100 100 k steps, as its authors prescribe. • E-MoE . In each of the D = 12 \text{D}=12 blocks the MLP is replaced by E = 8 \text{E}=8 experts of the same size, routed per token and per block. The forward pass commits to a single expert per token, so the parameters acting on a token match the dense baseline up to the routers ( 139.4 139.4 M against 139.3 139.3 M). Gradients flow through the renormalized top- 2 2 Gumbel-softmax weights with a straight-through estimator onto the selected expert. The temperature decays as τ h = max ( 0.1 , e − 3 × 10 − 5 h ) \tau_{h}=\max(0.1,\,e^{-3\times 10^{-5}h}) . The KL weight is fixed at 1.0 1.0 with no warmup, and there is no load-balancing term.

blocks.zh: 附录D 潜在影响和限制

blocks.en: Potential Impact. Our method may be particularly useful for LLaDA-style ( Nie et al., 2025 ) MDM, whose main practical promise is parallel generation through bidirectional denoising. The quality of such models at low NFE is limited by the factorized reverse process, when many masked positions are filled simultaneously, independently sampled token marginals can fail to agree globally. Our method offers a route to address this issue inside the denoiser itself. For MoE-based variants such as LLaDA-MoE ( Zhu et al., 2025a ) , the expert-routing decisions are already present in the architecture. E-MoE reinterprets these decisions as discrete shared latents and trains them to coordinate multi-token predictions. If this idea scales, it could improve the quality-speed trade-off of diffusion LLMs by allowing them to use fewer denoising steps without losing as much coherence.
blocks.zh: 潜在影响。 我们的方法对于LLADA风格(Nie等人,2025年)MDM可能特别有用,它的主要实际承诺是通过双向解密实现平行生成. 这种模型在低非常规外观中的质量受到因地制宜的反向过程的限制,当许多蒙面位置同时被填补时,独立抽样的代币边缘可能无法在全球达成一致. 我们的方法提供了一个途径 解决这个问题 在德诺瓦人本身。 对于基于教育部的变体,如LLaDA-MoE(Zhu等人,2025年a),在架构中已经存在专家路线决定. E-MOE将这些决定重新解释为离散的共享潜质,并对其进行训练,以协调多键预测. 如果这种想法能够扩大规模,就可以改进传播有限责任公司的质量-速度权衡,允许它们使用较少的去名步骤,而不会失去同样多的一致性。

blocks.en: Limitations. Our method addresses the factorization error most directly in the low-NFE regime, where many tokens are revealed per step. As the number of denoising steps increases, the benefit naturally diminishes because each reverse transition becomes easier to approximate with factorized marginals. The method also relies on meaningful router alignment: if the noisy router cannot recover the clean routing decisions, or if the routing distribution collapses, the mixture degenerates toward a single factorized component.
blocks.zh: 限制。 我们的方法最直接地解决低NFE制度中的因子化错误,其中每个步骤都会暴露出许多代币. 随着取消提名步骤的数量增加,惠益自然减少,因为每次逆向过渡都更容易与因数化边际相近。 该方法还依赖于有意义的路由器对齐:如果吵闹的路由器无法恢复干净的路由决定,或者如果路由分配崩溃,混合物会退化成单一的因子化成分.
